about.title: About this portal
about.intro: The Audit Status Portal is an unofficial convenience tool. It lets a person enter their 12-digit Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and instantly learn whether that TIN appears on the National Board of Revenue (NBR) audit-selection list for Assessment Year 2023–2024.
about.sourceBody: The list is sourced from the NBR audit-selection publication for Assessment Year 2023–2024 ({label}, published {date}). This site mirrors only what NBR has already published — nothing more.
about.meaningBody: Being selected means your income-tax return for the year may be examined in detail. It is a routine compliance process, not an accusation. If you are selected, keep your supporting records ready and respond to any notice from your tax circle.
about.nextBody: Whether or not your TIN appears here, treat NBR's own communication as authoritative. Visit your tax circle office or the official NBR website to confirm your status and obtain guidance.
about.unofficialTitle: This is not an official NBR service
about.unofficialBody: This portal is provided for convenience only. It is not operated by, endorsed by, or affiliated with the National Board of Revenue. Always verify your status through official channels.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers to common questions about this portal.

what.q: What does this site tell me?
what.a: It tells you whether your exact 12-digit TIN is on the published NBR audit-selection list for Assessment Year 2023–2024, and if so, the tax zone, circle, and submission type recorded against it.

official.q: Is this an official NBR website?
official.a: No. This is an unofficial convenience tool. The National Board of Revenue is the only authoritative source. Always confirm your status through official NBR channels.

store.a: No. Your TIN is checked against an in-memory list and the result is shown immediately. It is never written to a log, never placed in the web address, and never added to your browser history.

partial.q: Can I search by name or part of a TIN?
partial.a: No. Only an exact 12-digit match is supported. There is no name search, partial search, or autocomplete — this is a deliberate privacy protection.

notListed.q: My TIN isn't on the list. Am I safe from audit?
notListed.a: Not being on this particular list does not guarantee you will never be audited. Always rely on official NBR communication for your tax obligations.

wrong.q: The result looks wrong. What should I do?
wrong.a: This site reflects a published snapshot and may differ from NBR's live records. If something looks wrong, contact your tax circle or the NBR directly — their records are authoritative.

year.a: Only Assessment Year 2023–2024, from the corresponding published list. Other years are not included.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: How this portal protects the people it serves.
privacy.intro: This portal is designed so that checking your own status is easy, while making mass enumeration no easier than the already-public list.

exact.d: Lookups require a full, exact 12-digit TIN. There is no partial search, wildcard, prefix search, autocomplete, or "did you mean" — by design.

noLog.d: TINs are not written to application logs, analytics, or error reports. Each lookup is served with no-store and leaves no trace on our side.

noUrl.t: Never in the URL or history
noUrl.d: Your TIN never appears in the web address, query string, browser history, or any shareable link. Results render inline only.

noBulk.d: There is no bulk download or list-everyone endpoint. Public statistics contain counts only — never TINs.

rateLimit.d: Every lookup is rate limited to discourage scraping and automated enumeration.

minimal.d: The portal holds no personal information beyond the fields NBR already published: zone, circle, submission type, and assessment year.

privacy.contact: For questions about your actual tax status, contact the National Board of Revenue directly.

footer.disclaimer: Unofficial tool. Not affiliated with the National Board of Revenue. Verify your status with NBR.
footer.builtWith: Privacy-first lookup — no TIN is stored or logged.
